research.facts:
Verstappen Exit Clause
**[HIGH]** Exit clause is currently ACTIVE. It triggered automatically because Verstappen couldn't finish top-2 in the championship after the first half. He sits 6th with approximately 109 points.
**[HIGH]** Clause window runs August through October 2026.
**[HIGH]** No formal decision has been announced. Verstappen said only "There's nothing to say" when publicly pressed — twice.
**[HIGH]** Dutch GP at Zandvoort (Aug 21-23) is universally cited as natural announcement point — his "last home race" and the emotional setting.
**[HIGH]** Factories reopen August 17 (tomorrow). Expect wave of news through Dutch GP week.
**[MEDIUM]** McLaren is the most-discussed destination. Multiple sources (ESPN, Planet F1, RacingNews365) report talks advancing. However, ESPN sources described McLaren rumours as "wide of the mark."
**[MEDIUM]** An F1 insider (GPFans Aug 16) claims Verstappen's bond with Red Bull is "broken." Red Bull made a fresh contract offer with no response from Verstappen.
**[MEDIUM]** Mercedes listed as second major destination option. Both Mercedes 2027 seats officially listed as "not 100% confirmed" by F1.
**[HIGH]** Red Bull gets no compensation if clause is triggered.
research.sources: Sources: GPFans Transfer Roundup Aug 16, ESPN, RacingNews365, Planet F1.

research.facts:
Dutch GP Preview
**[HIGH]** Dutch GP August 21-23 at Zandvoort — 5 days away from today.
**[HIGH]** This is the FINAL Dutch GP at Zandvoort. Promoter confirmed no renewal beyond 2026.
**[HIGH]** First-ever Sprint weekend at Zandvoort circuit.
**[HIGH]** Sprint format means only ONE practice session before sprint qualifying — extremely challenging for setup.
**[HIGH]** 2026 F1 cars (350kW electrical power, no MGU-H, active aero) have ZERO Zandvoort data under current regulations.
**[MEDIUM]** 85% rain forecast for Sunday race day (Sky Sports).
**[HIGH]** Verstappen unveiled "Timeless" Delftware helmet on August 14 — blue/white ceramics inspired by Delft pottery, intricate florals, lion logo integrated. Verstappen: "One of my race wins came with a painted tile trophy like this... instead of going orange again, I wanted something unique for our final race here."
**[HIGH]** Verstappen called Zandvoort his "last home race" — generating emotional resonance in Dutch media.

research.facts:
Ferrari Upgrades
**[HIGH]** Lewis Hamilton receives an all-new chassis at Zandvoort.
**[HIGH]** Ferrari also bringing significant floor evolution at Zandvoort — fast-tracked after engineers identified improvements from Austrian and British GP data comparison.
**[HIGH]** ADUO-2 engine upgrade is NOT coming to Zandvoort. Reserved for Monza (Sept 4-6).
**[HIGH]** ADUO-2 specifics: completely redesigned turbocharger, same impeller diameter but revised blade count/angle and advanced materials. Power gain: +15 horsepower over current spec.
**[HIGH]** Ferrari simulations project ADUO-2 worth approximately +0.2 seconds per lap at Monza.
**[HIGH]** Fred Vasseur publicly stated ADUO-2 will help but ruled out fully closing the gap to Mercedes on power this season.
**[HIGH]** Ferrari's unusual engine strategy: Zandvoort (aero/chassis) → Monza (engine ADUO-2) → Singapore (combined both).
**[HIGH]** ADUO-1 debuted at Austrian GP earlier this season: modest +7-8 horsepower gain.

F1 Silly Season
**[HIGH]** GPFans published August 16 Transfer Roundup headlined: "Verstappen McLaren warning, Audi statement and FOURTEEN seats still open."
**[HIGH]** 14 of 20 2027 F1 race seats are not yet 100% confirmed — "remarkably unsettled grid" per sources. Driven primarily by the Verstappen domino effect.
**[MEDIUM]** Carlos Sainz in "final stages of negotiations with Williams for a new one-year contract" for 2027. Source: Spanish outlet Marca, cited by GPFans Aug 16.
**[HIGH]** Gabriel Bortoleto clarified his Audi contract runs "long-term" through at least 2028. Quiets rumours linking him to McLaren and others.
**[HIGH]** George Russell announced engagement to Carmen Montero Mundt during summer break (announced approximately August 9). Ring: oval yellow diamond.
**[HIGH]** Lewis Hamilton confirmed on Ferrari contract through at least 2027 (third year at Ferrari, confirmed at Canadian GP).
**[HIGH]** Lando Norris confirmed at McLaren through at least end of 2027.
**[MEDIUM]** Both Mercedes 2027 seats listed as "not 100% confirmed" for 2027 per official F1.
